title: DIVER-0: Fully Channel-Equivariant EEG Foundation Model
authors: Dongyeop Han, Ahhyun Lee, Taeyang Lee, Sebin Lee, Jiook Cha
summaryPoints: Formulates EEG sensor arrays as spatial point clouds with continuous coordinate embeddings.
Guarantees SE(3)/permutation equivariance across arbitrary electrode channel layouts (8 to 256 channels).
Enables seamless zero-shot cross-dataset transfer across heterogeneous clinical and research setups.
significance: Solves one of the largest obstacles in bio-signal AI: disparate electrode montages across worldwide hospital & research databases.
labRelevance: Developed by Connectome Lab members at SNU and MILA.
